name: The Librarian Girl Jasmine
source:
Meet the Librarian Girl Jasmine in this unconventional romantic comedy where you must make difficult choices that will lead you to one of several feel good or embarrassing endings.

Hold your head in your hands, or laugh hard trying, as you attempt to find the most wholesome ending in this short Visual Novel.

[From [url=https://zuripaigames.itch.io/the-librarian-girl-jasmine]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部非传统的浪漫喜剧中遇见图书管理员女孩茉莉花，你必须做出艰难的选择，这将导致你进入几个感觉良好或尴尬的结局之一。

当你试图在这部短篇视觉小说中找到最健康的结局时，双手抱住你的头，或者努力大笑。

[来自[url=https://zuripaigames.itch.io/the-librarian-girl-jasmine]itch.io[/url]]
